journey.name: spark transfer status
journey.description:
Verifies the transfer status screen after a transfer to spending through Spark, against the Figma section "Funds In Transfer (spark)". Every in-progress frame shows the nav title "Transfer Funds" with the menu and no back button, three steps, the active step's label under them and one bottom-pinned button; headlines show in capitals. A fast (Instant) transfer moves through "Processing Payment" (step 1, Spark has not listed the deposit), "Payment Successful" (step 1 done, Spark lists it) and "Adding To Spending Balance" (steps 1 and 2 done), all with the transfer arrows in dashed rings, and ends on "Transfer Successful" with the check and "Awesome!". A normal speed (Later) transfer shows the same steps with "This should take about 30 minutes.".
Whether Spark reprices the fast transfer or offers none is the provider's call, so those two frames (coins in place of the arrows) are conditional steps here; TransferStatusTest.kt and SettingUpScreenTest.kt cover every frame. On Spark's regtest a fast transfer can finish within seconds, so "Processing Payment" may show only briefly and Spark may claim the deposit before "Adding To Spending Balance" shows; a step once passed never comes back.
Precondition: as in spark-transfer-to-spending.xml: a dev build with Spark connected on its regtest and reading Bitkit's chain, Savings funded on that chain (at least 20 000 sats, confirmed) and no channels. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings"), tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending"), tap "25%" (testTag "SpendingAmountQuarter") and tap "Continue" (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify "Instant" (testTag "SpendingConfirmInstant") is selected and swipe to confirm

Verify the status screen (testTag "LightningSettingUp") shows "Transfer Funds", the headline "Funds in transfer", the text (testTag "SettingUpText") "Please wait, your funds transfer is in progress. This should take a few minutes.", step 1 active with "Processing Payment", and "Continue Using Bitkit" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")

Wait up to 3 minutes for "Payment Successful" with step 1 checked, then, if it shows before the transfer ends, "Adding To Spending Balance" with steps 1 and 2 checked; each keeps the same headline, text and button, and the label never goes back to an earlier step

If the fast transfer fee rose, verify the headline "Fast transfer fee changed", the text "The fast transfer fee is now ₿ …. Approve to access your funds quickly, or wait ±30 min.", the coins, the label "Fast Transfer Fee Changed" and "Wait" (testTag "SettingUpWait") and "Approve" (testTag "SettingUpPay") side by side; tap "Wait" and verify the headline "Funds in transfer", the text ending "about 30 minutes." and the label "Using Normal Transfer Speed" on step 3
If the fast transfer is unavailable, verify the headline "Fast transfer unavailable", the text ending "about 30 minutes.", the coins and the label "Using Normal Transfer Speed"

Wait for "Transfer Successful" (testTag "TransferSuccess"), up to 3 minutes for a fast transfer; after Wait or an unavailable fast transfer, up to 10 minutes for the deposit's 3 confirmations (Spark's regtest mines about once a minute): the headline "Funds moved to spending", "Your funds have been transferred and your spending balance is ready to use.", the check and "Awesome!" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")
Tap "Awesome!" and verify the wallet home screen shows the higher Spending balance

Start another transfer the same way, tap "Later" (testTag "SpendingConfirmLater"), swipe to confirm and verify the text ends "about 30 minutes." with step 1 active and "Processing Payment", then "Payment Successful" once Spark lists the deposit
